# Copilot instructions

Commit messages and pull-request descriptions follow
[.github/instructions/commits-and-pull-requests.instructions.md](instructions/commits-and-pull-requests.instructions.md):
every commit subject starts with the Linear ticket (`JOR-55: adding a button`), the last paragraph carries a `Refs:` trailer,
and a pull request uses the headings of `.github/pull_request_template.md` with a linking word (`Fixes JOR-23` or
`Refs JOR-23`). Project-wide rules are in `AGENTS.md`.
